query: 举报人保护机制 举报人保护机制 衡量企业是否建立并披露了制度化、可操作的举报渠道，以及对举报人实施保密、保护和禁止报复的正式机制。 2分：企业同时满足以下三项标准。第一，披露了具体的举报渠道。第二，明确承诺对举报人身份保密或允许匿名举报。第三，制定了禁止对举报人实施报复的政策或声明。 1分：企业满足上述2分标准中的任意一项或两项。或者，企业虽提及设有举报机制，但缺乏具体渠道描述、保密承诺或保护政策的任一项内容。 0分：企业在ESG报告、企业管治报告及公司官网中均未披露任何举报机制相关信息。或者，仅以“本公司设有举报制度”等笼统表述一笔带过，无任何可验证的具体内容。 举报人保护 举报机制 吹哨人 举报热线 匿名举报 保密举报 禁止报复 反舞弊举报 诉说政策 whistleblowing whistleblower protection speak-up reporting hotline anonymous reporting confidential reporting non-retaliation anti-fraud reporting 披露了哪些具体举报渠道（热线、邮箱、平台）？ 是否允许匿名或承诺保密？ 是否有禁止报复政策？ 可举报事项范围是什么？ 受理与反馈流程如何运作？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '举报人保护机制'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 披露了哪些具体举报渠道（热线、邮箱、平台）？ 是否允许匿名或承诺保密？ 是否有禁止报复政策？ 可举报事项范围是什么？ 受理与反馈流程如何运作？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“设有举报制度”无渠道；仅有员工申诉意见箱且无反舞弊定位；仅有客户投诉；仅有反腐政策而无举报机制细节；区分：举报人保护强调舞弊/合规举报渠道与反报复；员工申诉偏劳动权益；供应商申诉面向供应商；反贿赂政策是实体规范，不等于已建立可操作举报保护。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

[Content]
Consistent with the reporting principles of the 2020 Environmental, Social and Governance Report, this Report focuses on the Group's property investment and development business in China. Revenue from sale of property projects accounted for over 99% of the Group's total revenue in 2021; whereas revenue from property rental, hotel operations and other services only accounted for a relatively small portion of the Group's total revenue in 2021 and therefore the latter does not form part of the reporting boundary in this Report. The Group will review the reporting boundary regularly in the light of business development. results.text: During the Reporting Year, the Group conducted a materiality review to understand the sustainability issues of concern to stakeholders. This not only helps the Group further understand its operation situation, but also guides the Group to formulate proactive and targeted implementation plans. The materiality review adopted a combination of qualitative and quantitative assessments to identify the latest issues related to sustainable development trends in addition to existing material issues. The Group identified and defined twenty-one sustainability issues and megatrends related to the real estate industry, covering environmental protection, employment and labour practices, operating practices, community and innovation. Stakeholders from different business sectors were invited to interviews to understand their views on issues and establish sustainability strategies. Besides, through questionnaire surveys, Board members and employees were invited to rank various issues according to their perceived importance to the business and stakeholders. Based on the opinions of different parties, the following seven important sustainable development issues of the Group were sorted out and approved by the Board and the Executive Committee.
